title: Bowl of cereal
summary: The simplest 'recipe' there is: perfect for showing REMY off without turning on a hob.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a no-cook demo. Checked by Matthew on 2026-11-07.
notes: No heat, no knives: the safe demo. Remy's job here is mostly comedy (cereal-first vs milk-first) and showing the steps and the screen.
ingredients: About 150ml cold milk (or a plant milk)
Optional: a handful of berries or a sliced banana

steps.instruction: Pour the cereal into the bowl, about half full.
looks_right: cereal in the bowl, roughly half full
looks_wrong: milk poured in first (Remy will have opinions)
steps.done_when: The bowl is about half full of cereal.

steps.instruction: Pour in cold milk until it just reaches the top of the cereal.
looks_right: milk just level with the cereal
looks_wrong: bowl filled to the brim (it'll spill)
steps.done_when: The milk comes just up to the cereal.

steps.instruction: Add berries or banana on top if you like, then eat it straight away before it goes soggy.
looks_wrong: the bowl left to sit until the cereal goes soggy
steps.done_when: Spoon in hand. Breakfast is served.
